/* checkUserRights - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
NVL(MAX(INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT
NVL(MAX(DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT
NVL(MAX(REG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT
NVL(MAX(MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT
NVL(MAX(MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT

NVL(MAX(INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') AS RIGHT
